title: Git
description: Pick the Git command that solves the problem: setting up, staging and committing, reading history, undoing mistakes, branching, merging, rebasing, working with remotes, and recovering lost work.
note: Commands use the modern `git switch` and `git restore` where they exist (Git 2.23 and later); explanations mention the older `git checkout` form. `a1b2c3d` stands for any commit hash.
